# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| Latest  | ✅ Yes    |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in My KKR, please do NOT open a public GitHub issue.

Instead, email: security@mykkr.in (set this up before launch)

We will:
- Acknowledge your report within 48 hours
- Provide a fix within 7 days for critical issues
- Credit you in our changelog if you wish

## What to Report
- Authentication bypass
- Data exposure (customer phone numbers, emails)
- SQL injection
- XSS vulnerabilities
- CSRF vulnerabilities
- Exposed secrets or API keys

## Out of Scope
- Issues requiring physical access to the server
- Social engineering attacks
- Issues in third-party services (Razorpay, Firebase, etc.)
